selected_evidence.requirement: Keep installed curl at its current version during system updates
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline showed curl 8.5.0-2ubuntu10.8 unheld; the hold was applied, dpkg recorded it, and simulated upgrades before and after reboot scheduled no curl action.

Healthy baseline boot ID 267e568a-ef2b-4189-9a7f-50a72b044473 was captured, the safe reboot was acknowledged, and node1 returned running with changed boot ID aafe6b80-895f-41de-9381-713fdd9aa1c9; curl remained installed, executable, and held.

commands.command: printf 'BOOT_ID='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; printf 'SYSTEM_STATE='; systemctl is-system-running 2>&1 || true; printf 'CURL_PACKAGE='; dpkg-query -W -f='${Status} ${Version}\n' curl; printf 'CURL_HOLD_BEFORE='; apt-mark showhold | grep -Fx curl || printf 'not-held\n'

printf 'CURL_HOLD='; apt-mark showhold | grep -Fx curl; printf 'DPKG_SELECTION='; dpkg --get-selections curl; printf 'CURL_VERSION='; dpkg-query -W -f='${Version}\n' curl; printf 'SIMULATED_UPGRADE_CURL_ACTION='; apt-get -s upgrade 2>/dev/null | grep '^Inst curl ' || printf 'none\n'

printf 'BOOT_ID='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; printf 'SYSTEM_STATE='; systemctl is-system-running 2>&1 || true

printf 'POST_BOOT_ID='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; printf 'SYSTEM_STATE='; systemctl is-system-running 2>&1 || true; printf 'CURL_PACKAGE='; dpkg-query -W -f='${Status} ${Version}\n' curl; printf 'CURL_HOLD='; apt-mark showhold | grep -Fx curl; printf 'CURL_EXECUTABLE='; curl --version | sed -n '1p'; printf 'SIMULATED_UPGRADE_CURL_ACTION='; apt-get -s upgrade 2>/dev/null | grep '^Inst curl ' || printf 'none\n'
